definitions.explanation: A type of onion with long green stalks, commonly used as a garnish and ingredient in Japanese cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{葱|ねぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To add green onion to miso soup.

examples.japanese: {葱|ねぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{小口切|こぐちぎ}り→小口切り：23076_koguchigiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧する。
examples.english: To slice green onion into thin rounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{葱|ねぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{乗|の}せる→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧。
examples.english: To put lots of green onion on ramen.
I forgot to buy green onions.
I put green onion, tofu, and meat into the pot and simmered it.

notes:
{葱|ねぎ} is an essential ingredient in Japanese cuisine, used both as a main ingredient and as a garnish. The word covers several varieties that English distinguishes as separate vegetables.

TYPES:
- ⟦{長|なが}{葱|ねぎ}→長葱：noentry⟧/⟦{白|しろ}{葱|ねぎ}→白葱：noentry⟧: Japanese leek (thick, white part prominent)
- ⟦{青|あお}{葱|ねぎ}→青葱：noentry⟧/⟦{万能|ばんのう}{葱|ねぎ}→万能葱：noentry⟧: green onion/scallion (thin, mostly green)
- ⟦{小|こ}{葱|ねぎ}→小葱：noentry⟧: thin green onion (for garnishing)
- ⟦わけぎ→わけぎ：noentry⟧: Welsh onion

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{薬味|やくみ}→薬味：04964_yakumi⟧ (garnish): for ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧, ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧, ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧, ⟦{蕎麦|そば}→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (hot pot): cut into thick pieces
- ⟦{焼|や}き{鳥|とり}→焼き鳥：04952_yakitori⟧: grilled between pieces of chicken (ねぎま)

REGIONAL NOTE:
In eastern Japan (Kanto), {葱|ねぎ} typically refers to ⟦{長|なが}{葱|ねぎ}→長葱：noentry⟧ (the thick white type). In western Japan (Kansai), it usually means ⟦{青|あお}{葱|ねぎ}→青葱：noentry⟧ (the thin green type).
